name: tabpilot-vscode
description: VS Code client for the Tabpilot inline completion server.

tabpilot.serverPath.description: Absolute path to tabpilot-lsp. When empty, the extension uses ../target/debug/tabpilot-lsp relative to the extension folder.

tabpilot.provider.description: Model Provider used by the Completion Server (TABPILOT_PROVIDER).

tabpilot.harness.description: Coding agent the commonthread provider uses (TABPILOT_HARNESS); its default profile and a fast model are chosen automatically.

tabpilot.claude.model.description: Claude model (TABPILOT_CLAUDE_MODEL). Empty uses the server default (haiku).

tabpilot.claude.effort.description: Claude effort (TABPILOT_CLAUDE_EFFORT). Empty uses the server default (low).

tabpilot.commonthread.url.description: Shared Commonthread server URL (TABPILOT_COMMONTHREAD_URL); needs a token from "Tabpilot: Set Commonthread Token". Empty uses http://127.0.0.1:8080 when a token is set or ~/.config/commonthread/tabpilot.token exists. Without a running shared server, tabpilot starts its own.

tabpilot.commonthread.profile.description: Commonthread profile ID (TABPILOT_COMMONTHREAD_PROFILE). Empty uses the harness's default profile.

tabpilot.commonthread.model.description: Commonthread model (TABPILOT_COMMONTHREAD_MODEL). Empty uses haiku for Claude and gpt-6-luna for Codex.

tabpilot.trace.server.description: Trace communication with the Tabpilot language server.
